releaseNotes.headline: Clearer Claude connection and reset times
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.19 keeps connected Claude accounts free of extra sign-in prompts and makes unavailable reset times clear.

highlights.title: No extra sign-in
highlights.detail: Settings hides Sign In when the Claude desktop app is already supplying usage.

highlights.title: Honest reset countdowns
highlights.detail: When a provider has no reset timestamp, usage shows — instead of the quota window length.

highlights.title: Clear unavailable state
highlights.detail: Hover and accessibility text explain that the reset time is unavailable.
